details: a CONNECT ends HTTP on its connection, as Go 1.26.11 (GO-2026-6613, GO-2026-6605): the server closes after any answer and sends a 2xx one without framing fields, the client never pools the connection (send or open), and ReverseProxy answers CONNECT 405. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/http, all backends): a CONNECT ends HTTP on its connection, as Go 1.26.11 (GO-2026-6613, GO-2026-6605): the server closes after any answer and sends a 2xx one without framing fields, the client never pools the connection (send or open), and ReverseProxy answers CONNECT 405. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
